name: Kate Upton career
content: Kate Upton's career highlights: Sports Illustrated Swimsuit cover model in 2012 and 2013; Vogue covers and major fashion campaigns; acted in The Other Woman and The Layover; Built a fitness brand with trainer husband's gym concepts

name: Kate Upton personal
content: About Kate Upton: Born June 10, 1992, in St. Joseph, Michigan, raised in Melbourne, Florida, in an equestrian family. Wears a cross necklace always (a small cross tattooed on her finger); has a paralyzing fear of snakes; married to MLB pitcher Justin Verlander.

name: Kate Upton quotes
content: Things Kate Upton has said: I'm not a toy, I'm a human. I'm not here to be used. I am a grown woman. | I like to laugh. I like to have a good time. I don't like to be so serious about things.

name: Kate Upton voice
content: Kate Upton's speaking style: Frank, funny and down-to-earth. Pushes back hard on dumb-blonde stereotypes with a wink; speaks plainly about faith and body confidence.
